scope: Extend the existing same-file Windows report worker for the exact typed joined report. Strict producers and private native APIs; common command/frontend selection remains a subsequent gate.
definition: org.disked.report-worker-definition-prototype/2 binds the complete joined export, producer/current worker code, host/target and owned empty execution store. /1 acquisition-only definitions retain their meaning. Reject unknown versions or critical fields. Preparation creates nothing and must fit the complete 64 KiB canonical header using fixed-width provisional identity slots before review; definition-alone fit is insufficient.
grant: Exact outer definition_digest plus case_read, collection_read, report_write, store_write and host_effects are necessary before paths/effects. Inner-only digests do not grant execution-store effects. Reconstruction binds both source snapshots/metadata and the output effect. Matching repeated starts observe the retained operation without restart; conflicting or partial stores remain refused or unknown.
worker: Reuse the existing report role, fixed metadata filenames, inherited capability list/no standard handles, same-user aggregate/private process-memory limits, 3000 ms admission wait, hash chain, cancellation checkpoints and exact process identity observations. Select the typed adapter by validated definition version. Release source/output handles before a finished quiescent record. Historical reads confer no execution applicability or custody/current-image authority.
state: Shared state/record /2 bind the exact retained header/definition digest and process/attempt/worker identity. Joined outcomes have independent case/collection last observations and check_sequence (case odd, collection even), with source_checks <=256. Maximum last check equals source_checks. Completed requires final matched adjacent case/collection observations (minimum four visits), completed verified output and exact reviewed artifact counters. Invalid complete records or contradictory receipts cannot qualify progress. A torn suffix retains the prior validated state but makes observation unknown.
aliases: Reject original case/execution-store generation sharing and reserved execution-child aliases of output/selected collection through native ordinal path checks. Ordinary-file pins, producer checks and create-new output remain necessary. Never open original media paths from retained content.
qualification: Author expectations before evaluation. Run actual contained child exports using generated acquisition/verification collections. Independently validate headers/rows, original collection/output bytes, digests/code/store/operation/attempt/worker/process identities and actual OS exit. Test all 31 false-grant combinations, wrong/inner digests with zero effects, source recreation, admission timeout without restart, cancellation, observer departure, output/terminal persistence failures and retained partial outputs. Automatic schema semantics check bounded integers/bytes and cross-field relationships, including contradictory rehashed records. Retain acquisition-only native regressions.
next_gate: Select the joined source in common evidence.export with exact explicit authority, full public-envelope/reply/render budgets and actual CLI/stdio/GUI/TUI/shell review/execute/watch evidence. Full DE-W034, all scoped 0.1.0 platforms/storage and owner/privilege/release gates remain open.
